# RM Cleaning Pro LLC

> Family-owned, founder-led house cleaning company based in Butler, PA, offering professional house cleaning and deep cleaning services across Northern Pittsburgh (Allegheny & Butler Counties). Full trilingual support in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Free quotes by phone or text at (412) 960-0058.

RM Cleaning Pro brings 5 years of hands-on experience, high-quality pet-safe products, and a true commitment to every space we clean. The founder leads the work directly on-site.

## Services

- Regular Cleaning: recurring service, available weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly, for living spaces, bedrooms, bathrooms, and kitchen.
- Deep Cleaning: a thorough reset focusing on neglected areas, with pet-safe, non-toxic products.
- Move-In/Out Cleaning: cabinets sanitized and appliances detailed, for homes and rentals.
- Commercial Cleaning: after-hours cleaning for small offices and retail spaces in Greater Pittsburgh.
- Post-Construction Cleaning: drywall dust removal, floors, window tracks, and surfaces for newly renovated spaces.

## Service areas

Butler, Cranberry Township, Wexford, Gibsonia, Mars, Allison Park, Glenshaw, Moon Township, Carnegie, and Bridgeville, Pennsylvania.
